entries.text: Out of suffering have emerged the strongest souls; the most massive characters are seared with scars.
Your pain is the breaking of the shell that encloses your understanding.
Work is love made visible.
Your children are not your children. They are the sons and daughters of Life's longing for itself.
You may give them your love but not your thoughts, for they have their own thoughts.
The deeper that sorrow carves into your being, the more joy you can contain.
entries.ref: The Prophet, On Joy and Sorrow

entries.text: When you love you should not say, "God is in my heart," but rather, "I am in the heart of God."
Love has no other desire but to fulfill itself.
Love one another, but make not a bond of love: let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
Give your hearts, but not into each other's keeping. For only the hand of Life can contain your hearts.
Stand together, yet not too near together: for the pillars of the temple stand apart, and the oak tree and the cypress grow not in each other's shadow.
The teacher who is indeed wise does not bid you to enter the house of his wisdom but rather leads you to the threshold of your own mind.
No man can reveal to you aught but that which already lies half asleep in the dawning of your knowledge.
Say not, "I have found the truth," but rather, "I have found a truth."
Your soul is oftentimes a battlefield, upon which your reason and your judgment wage war against your passion and your appetite.
entries.ref: The Prophet, On Reason and Passion

entries.text: Rest in reason and move in passion.
entries.ref: The Prophet, On Reason and Passion

entries.text: Trust in dreams, for in them is hidden the gate to eternity.
Beauty is eternity gazing at itself in a mirror.
You are the bows from which your children as living arrows are sent forth.
The reality of the other person is not in what he reveals to you, but in what he cannot reveal to you.
Forget not that the earth delights to feel your bare feet and the winds long to play with your hair.
Silence is sometimes the best answer.
If you love somebody, let them go, for if they return, they were always yours.
The lust for comfort murders the passion of the soul.
You are good when you are one with yourself.
entries.ref: The Prophet, On Good and Evil
